mapper.insert: insert into pcd_user_quota_table (quota_id, quota_user_id, quota_total_capacity, quota_used_capacity, quota_file_count, quota_version) values(#{id}, #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{total_capacity}, #{used_capacity}, #{file_count}, #{version});
mapper.update: update pcd_user_quota_table set quota_total_capacity=#{total_capacity}, quota_used_capacity=#{used_capacity}, quota_file_count=#{file_count}, quota_version=#{version} where quota_user_id=#{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler};

UPDATE pcd_user_quota_table SET quota_used_capacity = quota_used_capacity + #{size}, quota_file_count = quota_file_count + 1, quota_version = quota_version + 1 WHERE quota_user_id = #{user_id, typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND quota_used_capacity + #{size} <= quota_total_capacity AND quota_version = #{version}
